Name: Lazy Deck
Description: Press less. Ship more. A sloth on your Stream Deck that takes over the whole deck when something needs you, plus everyday keys for music, Discord and Steam. Nothing to set up.

com.lazydeck.plugin.sloth.Name: Sam
com.lazydeck.plugin.sloth.Tooltip: Sleeps while everything's quiet. Wakes up and pulses when something is waiting for you. Press it to bring the alarm onto the whole deck.

com.lazydeck.plugin.test.Name: Test alarm
com.lazydeck.plugin.test.Tooltip: Fires a sample alarm so you can see how your deck reacts.

com.lazydeck.plugin.mic.Name: Microphone
com.lazydeck.plugin.mic.Tooltip: Mutes your system mic for every app at once: Discord, Teams, Zoom, OBS. The key shows the real state.

com.lazydeck.plugin.output.Name: Switch output
com.lazydeck.plugin.output.Tooltip: Switches sound between your devices: headphones, speakers, monitor. Virtual devices (Voicemod, Loopback …) are skipped. Or pick exactly two.

com.lazydeck.plugin.media.Name: Music
com.lazydeck.plugin.media.Tooltip: Play/pause, next, previous, volume. Works with Spotify, YouTube, the browser and most players.

com.lazydeck.plugin.media.playpause.Name: Play / Pause
com.lazydeck.plugin.media.playpause.Tooltip: Plays or pauses your music: Spotify, YouTube, browser and most players. When something's playing, Sam has his eyes open.

com.lazydeck.plugin.media.volumedown.Name: Volume down
com.lazydeck.plugin.media.volumedown.Tooltip: Turns everything down and shows where the volume is.

com.lazydeck.plugin.media.volumeup.Name: Volume up
com.lazydeck.plugin.media.volumeup.Tooltip: Turns everything up and shows where the volume is.

com.lazydeck.plugin.media.mute.Name: Volume / Mute
com.lazydeck.plugin.media.mute.Tooltip: Shows the volume as a sign on a branch. Press to mute and unmute.

com.lazydeck.plugin.nowplaying.Name: Now playing
com.lazydeck.plugin.nowplaying.Tooltip: Shows the cover and title of whatever's playing (Spotify, YouTube, browser …). Press: play/pause.

com.lazydeck.plugin.radio.Name: Radio
com.lazydeck.plugin.radio.Tooltip: Plays a radio station, one press on, one press off. Nothing to install, no account.

com.lazydeck.plugin.appvolume.Name: App volume
com.lazydeck.plugin.appvolume.Tooltip: Louder, quieter or muted, just for one app: the game in front, Discord, Spotify, browser … or everything together. On a dial: turn and press.

com.lazydeck.plugin.appvolume.fgdown.Name: Game quieter
com.lazydeck.plugin.appvolume.fgdown.Tooltip: Turns down only the game (or the app in front), Discord and music stay the same.

com.lazydeck.plugin.appvolume.fgup.Name: Game louder
com.lazydeck.plugin.appvolume.fgup.Tooltip: Turns up only the game (or the app in front).

com.lazydeck.plugin.appmic.Name: App mic
com.lazydeck.plugin.appmic.Tooltip: Mutes the mic for just one app, e.g. Teams, Zoom or Meet in the browser. Other apps can still hear you. The key shows the real state.

com.lazydeck.plugin.appmic.teams.Name: Teams mic
com.lazydeck.plugin.appmic.teams.Tooltip: Mutes only the mic in Microsoft Teams.

com.lazydeck.plugin.appmic.zoom.Name: Zoom mic
com.lazydeck.plugin.appmic.zoom.Tooltip: Mutes only the mic in Zoom.

com.lazydeck.plugin.appmic.browser.Name: Meet mic (browser)
com.lazydeck.plugin.appmic.browser.Tooltip: Mutes the mic in your browser, e.g. in Google Meet or Jitsi.

com.lazydeck.plugin.discord.Name: Discord
com.lazydeck.plugin.discord.Tooltip: Mute your mic, deafen, or open Discord. Mutes only Discord, whichever mic is selected there.

com.lazydeck.plugin.discord.mute.Name: Discord mic
com.lazydeck.plugin.discord.mute.Tooltip: Mutes only Discord, no matter which mic is picked there. The key shows the real state.

com.lazydeck.plugin.discord.deafen.Name: Discord deafen
com.lazydeck.plugin.discord.deafen.Tooltip: Discord hears and sends nothing: sound and mic off together.

com.lazydeck.plugin.steam.Name: Steam
com.lazydeck.plugin.steam.Tooltip: Starts your last played game, or opens your library, friends, store or Big Picture.

com.lazydeck.plugin.steam.last.Name: Last played
com.lazydeck.plugin.steam.last.Tooltip: Launches the Steam game you played last.

com.lazydeck.plugin.steam.friends.Name: Steam friends
com.lazydeck.plugin.steam.friends.Tooltip: Opens your friends list in Steam.

com.lazydeck.plugin.steam.bigpicture.Name: Steam Big Picture
com.lazydeck.plugin.steam.bigpicture.Tooltip: Starts Steam in Big Picture mode, for TVs and controllers.

com.lazydeck.plugin.steamdownloads.Name: Steam downloads
com.lazydeck.plugin.steamdownloads.Tooltip: How far along Steam's downloads are. When a big download finishes, Sam lets you know, even without this key.

com.lazydeck.plugin.gamebar.Name: Gaming
com.lazydeck.plugin.gamebar.Tooltip: Xbox Game Bar: save the last 30 seconds, start/stop recording, game screenshot, open Game Bar.

com.lazydeck.plugin.gamebar.clip.Name: Save last 30 s
com.lazydeck.plugin.gamebar.clip.Tooltip: Save the last 30 s with the Windows Xbox Game Bar.

com.lazydeck.plugin.gamebar.record.Name: Recording on/off
com.lazydeck.plugin.gamebar.record.Tooltip: Recording on/off with the Windows Xbox Game Bar.

com.lazydeck.plugin.gamebar.shot.Name: Game screenshot
com.lazydeck.plugin.gamebar.shot.Tooltip: Game screenshot with the Windows Xbox Game Bar.

com.lazydeck.plugin.gamebar.open.Name: Open Game Bar
com.lazydeck.plugin.gamebar.open.Tooltip: Opens the Windows Xbox Game Bar.

com.lazydeck.plugin.brightness.Name: Brightness
com.lazydeck.plugin.brightness.Tooltip: Screen brighter or darker, external monitors too (via DDC/CI, like Twinkle Tray). On a dial: turn.

com.lazydeck.plugin.brightness.down.Name: Darker
com.lazydeck.plugin.brightness.down.Tooltip: All screens darker, external monitors too.

com.lazydeck.plugin.brightness.up.Name: Brighter
com.lazydeck.plugin.brightness.up.Tooltip: All screens brighter, external monitors too.

com.lazydeck.plugin.windows.Name: Windows
com.lazydeck.plugin.windows.Tooltip: Lock, screen off, sleep, dark mode, recycle bin, screenshot, desktop, settings, Task Manager.

com.lazydeck.plugin.windows.sleep.Name: Sleep
com.lazydeck.plugin.windows.sleep.Tooltip: Put the PC to sleep. Press twice, just to be safe.

com.lazydeck.plugin.windows.recyclebin.Name: Empty Recycle Bin
com.lazydeck.plugin.windows.recyclebin.Tooltip: Empty the Recycle Bin. Press twice, just to be safe.

com.lazydeck.plugin.window.Name: Window
com.lazydeck.plugin.window.Tooltip: Snap, maximize or minimize windows, virtual desktops, Task View, project to a second screen.

com.lazydeck.plugin.awake.Name: Stay awake
com.lazydeck.plugin.awake.Tooltip: Your PC and screen won't fall asleep while the key is on: for downloads, presentations, movies.

com.lazydeck.plugin.sleeptimer.Name: Shutdown timer
com.lazydeck.plugin.sleeptimer.Tooltip: PC off or asleep in 30, 60 or 90 minutes, e.g. during a movie at night. Press again: 30 more minutes, hold: cancel. Sam gives you a heads-up a minute before.

com.lazydeck.plugin.clock.Name: Clock
com.lazydeck.plugin.clock.Tooltip: Time, weekday, date and week number.

com.lazydeck.plugin.weather.Name: Weather
com.lazydeck.plugin.weather.Tooltip: Weather for where you are, no setup. Your location comes from your IP address (ipwho.is), the weather from Open-Meteo.

com.lazydeck.plugin.timers.Name: Timer & countdown
com.lazydeck.plugin.timers.Tooltip: Kitchen timer, stopwatch, or a countdown to the end of the workday or the weekend.

com.lazydeck.plugin.timer.Name: Timer
com.lazydeck.plugin.timer.Tooltip: Kitchen timer: press to start/pause, hold to reset. When it runs out, Sam lets you know.

com.lazydeck.plugin.stopwatch.Name: Stopwatch
com.lazydeck.plugin.stopwatch.Tooltip: Press to start/stop, hold to reset.

com.lazydeck.plugin.countdown.Name: Countdown
com.lazydeck.plugin.countdown.Tooltip: How long until the workday's over or the weekend.

com.lazydeck.plugin.countdown.feierabend.Name: Until end of day
com.lazydeck.plugin.countdown.feierabend.Tooltip: How long until the end of your workday (5 pm, adjustable).

com.lazydeck.plugin.countdown.weekend.Name: Until weekend
com.lazydeck.plugin.countdown.weekend.Tooltip: How long until Friday's end of work.

com.lazydeck.plugin.reminder.Name: Reminder
com.lazydeck.plugin.reminder.Tooltip: Reminds you to drink or move at regular intervals. Press it to mark it done.

com.lazydeck.plugin.reminder.water.Name: Drink water
com.lazydeck.plugin.reminder.water.Tooltip: Reminds you to drink every hour. Press to mark it done.

com.lazydeck.plugin.reminder.move.Name: Move
com.lazydeck.plugin.reminder.move.Tooltip: Reminds you to move every 45 minutes. Press to mark it done.

com.lazydeck.plugin.status.Name: Status
com.lazydeck.plugin.status.Tooltip: Shows live how your PC is doing: internet, Wi-Fi, battery, or CPU and memory.

com.lazydeck.plugin.internet.Name: Internet
com.lazydeck.plugin.internet.Tooltip: Shows how fast your internet responds. If it's gone for 30 seconds, Sam lets you know.

com.lazydeck.plugin.battery.Name: Battery
com.lazydeck.plugin.battery.Tooltip: Battery level and whether it's charging (laptops). On a desktop: mains power.

com.lazydeck.plugin.apps.Name: Launch app
com.lazydeck.plugin.apps.Tooltip: Starts an app with one press: Spotify, Discord, Steam, WhatsApp, Telegram, WeChat, LINE, KakaoTalk, Teams, OBS, Explorer, Terminal, Notepad.

com.lazydeck.plugin.apps.teams.Name: Launch Microsoft Teams
com.lazydeck.plugin.apps.teams.Tooltip: Launches Microsoft Teams with one press.

com.lazydeck.plugin.apps.obs.Name: Launch OBS Studio
com.lazydeck.plugin.apps.obs.Tooltip: Launches OBS Studio with one press.

com.lazydeck.plugin.apps.explorer.Name: Launch Explorer
com.lazydeck.plugin.apps.explorer.Tooltip: Launches File Explorer with one press.

com.lazydeck.plugin.website.Name: Website
com.lazydeck.plugin.website.Tooltip: Opens a site in your browser: YouTube, Netflix, Twitch, Gmail, WhatsApp Web, Telegram Web, Prime Video, Disney+, Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, Google Maps, DeepL.

com.lazydeck.plugin.website.whatsappweb.Name: Open WhatsApp Web
com.lazydeck.plugin.website.whatsappweb.Tooltip: Opens WhatsApp Web in your browser.

com.lazydeck.plugin.website.prime.Name: Open Prime Video
com.lazydeck.plugin.website.prime.Tooltip: Opens Prime Video in your browser.

com.lazydeck.plugin.website.maps.Name: Open Google Maps
com.lazydeck.plugin.website.maps.Tooltip: Opens Google Maps in your browser.

com.lazydeck.plugin.website.deepl.Name: Open DeepL Translator
com.lazydeck.plugin.website.deepl.Tooltip: Opens DeepL Translator in your browser.

com.lazydeck.plugin.website.telegramweb.Name: Open Telegram Web
com.lazydeck.plugin.website.telegramweb.Tooltip: Opens Telegram Web in your browser.

com.lazydeck.plugin.folder.Name: Folder
com.lazydeck.plugin.folder.Tooltip: Opens Downloads, Documents, Pictures, Desktop, Music, Videos or your user folder.

com.lazydeck.plugin.tools.Name: Tools
com.lazydeck.plugin.tools.Tooltip: Clipboard history, emoji, notifications, calculator, paste today's date, secure password.

com.lazydeck.plugin.tools.password.Name: Generate password
com.lazydeck.plugin.tools.password.Tooltip: Generates a password and copies it to the clipboard.

com.lazydeck.plugin.chance.Name: Coin & dice
com.lazydeck.plugin.chance.Tooltip: Coin flip (heads shows Sam) or dice. For every decision you'd rather not make yourself.

com.lazydeck.plugin.chance.coin.Name: Coin flip
com.lazydeck.plugin.chance.coin.Tooltip: Heads or tails. Heads shows Sam.

com.lazydeck.plugin.system.Name: System
com.lazydeck.plugin.system.Tooltip: CPU and memory. Press to open Task Manager.

com.lazydeck.plugin.pomodoro.Name: Pomodoro
com.lazydeck.plugin.pomodoro.Tooltip: 25 minutes of focus, 5 minutes of break. Press: start/pause, hold: reset. Sam lets you know when time's up.

com.lazydeck.plugin.github.Name: GitHub
com.lazydeck.plugin.github.Tooltip: Unread notifications or reviews waiting for you. Uses the gh CLI you're already signed in to. New review requests raise an alarm.

com.lazydeck.plugin.github.notifications.Name: GitHub notifications
com.lazydeck.plugin.github.notifications.Tooltip: Unread GitHub notifications. Uses the gh-CLI you're signed in with.

com.lazydeck.plugin.github.reviews.Name: GitHub reviews
com.lazydeck.plugin.github.reviews.Tooltip: Reviews waiting for you. New ones trigger an alarm.

Battery level and whether it's charging (laptops). On a desktop PC: mains power.
Localization.Alarm aus jedem Skript auslösen:: Trigger an alert from any script:
Get up, stretch, take a deep breath.
Localization.Bildschirm heller oder dunkler, auch ext: Make the screen brighter or darker, external monitors too (via DDC/CI, like Twinkle Tray). On a dial: turn it.
Localization.CPU und Arbeitsspeicher. Drücken öffnet: CPU and memory. Press to open Task Manager.
Localization.Das Faultier schläft, solange alles ruhi: The sloth sleeps as long as everything is calm. When an alert comes in, it wakes up and pulses. Waiting alerts take over the whole deck after 2 minutes, errors right away. Press it to bring the alert onto the deck right now.
Localization.Der PC und der Bildschirm schlafen nicht: Your PC and screen won't fall asleep while the key is on: for downloads, presentations, movies.
Localization.Drücken startet/stoppt, halten setzt zur: Press to start/stop, hold to reset.
Localization.Drückt die Medientasten deines Systems:: Presses your system's media keys: Spotify, YouTube, browsers and most players listen to them.
Localization.Eieruhr: drücken startet/pausiert, halte: Kitchen timer: press to start/pause, hold to reset. When it runs out, Sam lets you know.
A glass of water, then back to it.
Localization.Erinnert dich regelmäßig ans Trinken ode: Reminds you to drink or move regularly. Pressing means done.
Localization.Erkläre auf Deutsch in höchstens fünf ku: Explain in English in at most five short sentences what this message probably means and what I should check next. No introduction, no follow-up questions.
Localization.Für „Erklären“ nutzt Lazy Deck die Claud: For “Explain”, Lazy Deck uses the Claude CLI if it's installed. It wasn't found or didn't respond.
Localization.In einer Minute. Taste am Timer gedrückt: In one minute. Hold the timer key to cancel.
Localization.Installieren: npm install -g @anthropic-: Install: npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code, then run "claude" once and sign in.
Localization.Lauter, leiser oder stumm, nur für eine: Louder, quieter or mute, for just one app: the game in front, Discord, Spotify, browser … or everything at once. On a dial: turn and press.
Localization.Lazy Deck liest deine lokale Steam-Bibli: Lazy Deck reads your local Steam library, no login needed. The key shows the game you played last.
Localization.Löst sofort einen Beispiel-Alarm aus und: Fires a sample alert right away and switches to the alert profile.
Localization.Münzwurf (Kopf zeigt Sam) oder Würfel. F: Coin flip (heads shows Sam) or dice. For all the decisions you'd rather not make yourself.
Localization.Name: Name
Localization.Nutzt die GitHub-CLI „gh“ (auch in WSL),: Uses the GitHub CLI “gh” (also in WSL) you're already signed in to. It checks every 2 minutes; new review requests trigger an alert.
Localization.PC aus oder schlafen in 30, 60 oder 90 M: PC off or asleep in 30, 60 or 90 minutes, e.g. during a movie at night. Press again: 30 more minutes, hold: cancel. Sam gives you a heads-up one minute before.
Localization.Press less. Ship more. A sloth on your S: Press less. Ship more. A sloth on your Stream Deck that takes over the whole deck when something needs you, plus everyday keys for music, Discord and Steam. Nothing to set up.
Localization.Schaltet das Mikro nur für eine App stum: Mutes the mic for just one app, e.g. Teams, Zoom or Meet in the browser. Other apps still hear you. The key shows the real state.
Localization.Schaltet den Ton zwischen deinen Geräten: Switches audio between your devices: headphones, speakers, monitor. Virtual devices (Voicemod, Loopback …) are skipped. Or pick exactly two.
Localization.Schaltet nur Discord stumm, direkt in Wi: Mutes only Discord, right in Windows, no matter which mic is picked in Discord. Nothing to set up. Discord's own mute icon stays off, the key shows the real state. Deafen mutes Discord's audio and mic together.
Localization.So meldet sich Sam, wenn etwas auf dich: This is how Sam lets you know something's waiting for you. View, Later or just any key.
Localization.Spielt einen Radiosender, ein Druck an,: Plays a radio station, one press on, one press off. Nothing to install, no account.
Localization.Wie lange noch bis Feierabend oder Woche: How long until the workday's over or the weekend.
Localization.Zeigt, wie schnell das Internet antworte: Shows how fast the internet responds. If it's gone for 30 seconds, Sam lets you know.
